TABLE.NAME: bunamrag
TABLE.COMMENT: Stores the bunamrag activity module instances.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course this activity is part of.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the activity module instance

FIELD.NAME: ragcoursecode
FIELD.COMMENT: Code of the course into B@RAG Hub

FIELD.NAME: dxfid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course activity that is a initial fundamental diagnostic of unit

FIELD.NAME: dxeid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the course activity that is a initial enrichment diagnostic of unit

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was added to the course.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified.

TABLE.NAME: bunamrag_contents
TABLE.COMMENT: Strores the B@RAG contents for subtheme container

FIELD.NAME: ragcoursecode
FIELD.COMMENT: Code of the course into B@RAG Hub

FIELD.NAME: ragunit
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the unit of the course into B@RAG Hub.

FIELD.NAME: ragunitid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the unit of the course into B@RAG Hub.

FIELD.NAME: ragtheme
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the theme of the course into B@RAG Hub.

FIELD.NAME: ragthemeid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the theme of the course into B@RAG Hub.

FIELD.NAME: ragsubtheme
FIELD.COMMENT: Name of the subtheme of the course into B@RAG Hub.

FIELD.NAME: ragsubthemesection
FIELD.COMMENT: Section for the content into B@RAG Hub.

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was added to the course.

FIELD.NAME: timemodified
FIELD.COMMENT: Timestamp of when the instance was last modified.
